skill.name: memory
skill.description: Manage project memory, SSOT files, and cross-tool memory search for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
skill.summary: Manage project memory and promote durable decisions into SSOT files.
skill.author: Chachamaru127

security_audit.summary: Most external-command and obfuscation alerts are false positives caused by markdown examples, Japanese text, and inline tool names. I confirmed filesystem risk where the skill points outside the skill directory into hidden .claude memory and state paths.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md links to ../../.claude/memory/decisions.md through path traversal.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the traversal link with a workspace-relative explanation and request user approval before reading hidden memory files.

remediation.issue: The SSOT setup guidance references hidden .claude memory and state paths.
remediation.suggestion: List the exact files before any write, explain their future agent impact, and create them only after confirmation.

remediation.issue: Shell examples appear in plans-merging.md while the top-level skill allows Bash.
remediation.suggestion: Mark the examples as pseudocode or add explicit safeguards for quoted paths, local-only commands, backups, and diff review.

content.user_title: Manage Project Memory and SSOT Records
content.value_statement: Project teams lose decisions across agents and sessions. This skill organizes SSOT memory, searches shared observations, and promotes durable decisions for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Initializes project SSOT memory files for decisions, patterns, and session logs.
Searches shared Harness Memory observations and related memory timelines.
Promotes durable learnings into decisions.md and patterns.md with separation by purpose.
Synchronizes Plans.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and workflow rule references when requested.
Preserves existing Plans.md tasks while updating marker legends and status sections.
Supports migration workflows with backups, diff review, and user confirmation.
limitations: Requires project file access and available memory tools in the active environment.
Does not decide which confidential information is safe to store without user review.
Can update hidden .claude memory paths, so users should review changes before approval.
Does not replace project policy, legal, or security review for stored decisions.

use_cases.title: Recover Past Decisions
use_cases.description: Find previous architecture decisions and summarize the rationale before new implementation work starts.

use_cases.title: Promote Session Learning
use_cases.description: Turn important discoveries from shared memory into durable decisions and reusable patterns.

use_cases.title: Migrate Workflow Files
use_cases.description: Update Plans.md and agent instruction files while preserving current tasks and important local rules.
use_cases.target_user: Teams adopting a shared agent workflow

prompt_templates.title: Find Past Decisions
prompt_templates.prompt: Use memory to find prior decisions about [topic]. Summarize dates, rationale, and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Record Session Learning
prompt_templates.prompt: Record this lesson for future sessions: [lesson]. Put durable decisions and reusable methods in the right SSOT files.

prompt_templates.title: Promote Memory to SSOT
prompt_templates.prompt: Search shared memory for observations about [feature]. Propose which items belong in decisions.md and patterns.md before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate Workflow Memory
prompt_templates.prompt: Review AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and Plans.md. Preserve current tasks, create backups, and propose a minimal migration plan for approval.

output_examples.input: Find previous architecture decisions about caching.
output_examples.output: A concise decision summary with dates, rationale, matching memory sources, and unresolved questions.

output_examples.input: Promote what we learned about test stability to SSOT.
output_examples.output: Suggested decisions and reusable patterns, separated by purpose, with a request for confirmation before file edits.

output_examples.input: Migrate my old workflow files without losing current tasks.
output_examples.output: A backup plan, preserved task list, proposed marker updates, and a diff-focused completion summary.

best_practices: Review proposed SSOT entries before allowing writes to project memory files.
Keep confidential information out of shared memory unless project policy explicitly allows it.
Use the search workflow before recording new decisions to avoid duplicate entries.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill for ordinary implementation work that does not touch memory or SSOT files.
Do not promote rough notes, secrets, or one-time tasks into durable project memory.
Do not run migration steps without checking backups and reviewing the proposed diff.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages project memory workflows, SSOT files, shared memory search, and selected workflow document synchronization.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it write files automatically?
faq.answer: It can write memory and workflow files when the active agent has permission, so users should confirm proposed edits.

faq.question: Can it search past memory?
faq.answer: Yes. It prioritizes Harness Memory tools and can use project memory files when available.

faq.question: What should not be stored?
faq.answer: Avoid storing secrets, personal data, low-confidence notes, and one-time task details in shared SSOT memory.

faq.question: Is this only for new projects?
faq.answer: No. It also supports migration and synchronization of existing project workflow files.
